assets.name: BloxFrontLogo
assets.notes: 512x512 app icon / title emblem (Figma file KEo76KefNk9UeH2BhNyMhM, node 1:2). Replaces Snick's logo id in src/shared/Assets/Branding.luau (app_icon, logo_mark) and UiIcons.luau (app_icon). Also usable as the experience icon.

assets.name: BloxFrontIcon
assets.notes: 512x512 experience icon (Creator Dashboard > Places > Icon). Figma node 53:2. Also usable as the in-game app_icon (Branding.luau / UiIcons.luau).

assets.name: SfxPack
